recommendations.action: Audit terminal operations at Ozone Park-Lefferts Blvd during the affected hours: crew reporting, car availability, turnaround time
recommendations.rationale: Trains leave the terminal already late.
recommendations.expected_effect: On-time departures remove the delay at the source.

recommendations.action: Prioritise signal maintenance / CBTC inspection on Chambers St -> Canal St
recommendations.rationale: Signal alerts coincide with problem arrivals; recurring signal faults on one segment are usually a component issue.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removes the recurring gap source; typical APT reduction equals the segment's median excess run time.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for A, C, E; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for A, C, E; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Pre-position a signal maintainer during the affected hours on days with active work orders
recommendations.rationale: Response time dominates the delay length for signal failures.
recommendations.expected_effect: Shorter incident duration, fewer 50+ train major incidents.

recommendations.action: During the affected hours, check alerts for 'A, C, E' before entering; use the alternate routes other lines at the station when a signal alert is posted
recommendations.rationale: Signal-caused gaps last tens of minutes; alternates are usually unaffected.

recommendations.action: Review dispatcher holding practice upstream of 14 St; consider publishing hold reasons in the feed
recommendations.rationale: ETAs drift substantially before problem arrivals, indicating holds.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer discretionary holds; more accurate countdown clocks.
